reason: I already have an SMS account that works, and at my volume of a few thousand messages 0.56 or 0.58 a message is not a saving my accountant would notice. Sinhala messages still eat extra credits here too, so nothing actually changes for me.
objection: My customers mostly get Sinhala messages, and if each one costs two or three credits the real price is more than 1.20 a message, so the cheap headline rate means nothing until I see what my actual messages cost.
would_change_my_mind: A clear rate showing a normal Sinhala message counts as one credit, or a real per-message price clearly lower than what I pay now, with a few hundred free test SMS so I can check delivery before my 11.11 sale.
